# #TOOLING — Handcrafted Woodworking Tools

> Bespoke woodworking mallets, awls, and tools handcrafted from exotic timbers. Every piece unique. Made to order in the UK.

## About
#TOOLING makes premium handcrafted woodworking mallets and awls from over 75 species of exotic timber. Each tool features brass dowel construction for superior strength and balance. Based in the UK, shipping worldwide.

## Products
- Custom woodworking mallets (carving, detailing, framing — turned and square styles)
- Marking awls with exotic wood handles and metal ferrules
- EDC coins
- Raw exotic timber blanks
- All products available in 75+ wood species including Ebony, Cocobolo, Purpleheart, Lignum Vitae, Bocote, Ziricote, and more

## Custom Builder
Customers can design their own mallet or awl by choosing:
- Tool style/size
- Head wood species
- Handle wood species
- Transition metal (brass, copper, bronze, aluminium, steel, mokume gane)
Pricing is calculated dynamically based on material selections.

## Key Differentiators
- Brass dowel construction (not mortise-and-tenon) for superior joint strength
- 75+ exotic wood species — far more than any competitor
- Every piece individually handcrafted — no batch production
- Interactive online builder for custom configurations
- Wood species library with Janka hardness data, origin, and grain characteristics

## Pricing
- Mallets: from approximately £60-200 depending on wood species and style
- Awls: from approximately £30-80
- Custom commissions: priced individually based on complexity
